title: Reading Energy Differences in Quantum Chemistry: Sparse References and Mixed Estimators
summary: English in-depth review of how sparse references reduce quantum-chemical energy measurement. Derives reference–residual decomposition, mixed estimators, sign and symmetry conditions, approximate-state errors and measurement statistics, with a synthetic two-level model and five solved exercises. Separates actual Helios shots and postselection from ideal precision estimates and distinct SVD-THC logical resources. No independent rerun of molecular calculations or QPU experiments.
title_en: Reading Energy Differences in Quantum Chemistry: Sparse References and Mixed Estimators
summary_en: Complete English review with derivations, synthetic two-level examples and counterexamples, measurement allocation, Helios results and five solved exercises. Reported experimental results and independent teaching calculations are clearly separated.
